title: ¿Por dónde?
goal: Ask the way and get an answer with no street names in it
culture: Nobody here navigates by street names, even the ones that have them. Directions are blocks, and the two fixed points are the lake and the mountain: al lago is east and arriba is west, towards Mombacho. Learn those two words and the city becomes legible.

beats.good: ¿Dónde queda? is where something is located, and it is the question you will ask most often in your first month.

beats.es: Ahí nomás. Dos cuadras al lago y ya la ve.
beats.objective: Say it back to be sure
beats.good: Al lago means east, because the lake is east of everything in this city. Repeating the direction back is how you avoid walking twenty minutes the wrong way.

beats.es: Al lago, sí. Y si se pasa, se devuelve para arriba.
beats.good: Arriba is west, towards Mombacho, and it has nothing to do with up. Al lago and arriba are the whole compass here.

beats.es: Así es, mi hijo. Vaya con cuidado.
beats.good: Cuídese back at somebody who has just looked after you is the whole of good manners here, and it costs one word.
